edit.scope: Whether an organism can have more than one brask-partner.

direct.prompt: Can one organism be related by 'has as brask-partner' to two different organisms?

derived.prompt: Drimella tasca's brask-partner is Tressia milvana, and Tressia milvana and Quessia lorvana are different species. Could Quessia lorvana also be Drimella tasca's brask-partner?
bridge: Drimella tasca's brask-partner is Tressia milvana, and Tressia milvana and Quessia lorvana are different species.
chain: Drimella tasca's brask-partner is Tressia milvana. (given in prompt)
Tressia milvana and Quessia lorvana are different species. (given in prompt)
So a second, different brask-partner is ruled out: no.

chain: Ostrecca velunda's brask-partner is Velunia sarcosa. (given in prompt)
Ostrecca velunda's brask-partner is also Morvessa tarnicola. (given in prompt)
So the two names pick out one species: yes.

'Has as brask-partner' is functional..why: Made-up species and a made-up relation: every name is absent from Dolma, and web searches find nothing by these names.
